organization: Rhode Island Office of Veterans Services (RIVETS), Veterans Resource Center
source_title: Rhode Island Office of Veterans Services: About Us
note: Rhode Island has one statewide Veterans Resource Center, in Warwick (Kent County). The Office of Veterans Services offers benefits counseling and help applying for VA and state programs at no charge.

evidence.selection: Rhode Island has no county veterans offices. The Office of Veterans Services’ About Us page (read in full) places the statewide Veterans Resource Center at 560 Jefferson Boulevard in Warwick but lists no phone; the phone, 401-921-2119, comes from the office’s 2021 statement (https://vets.ri.gov/press-releases/rivets-statement-services-and-supports-vets-military-families) and the suite number from the Division of Motor Vehicles’ veteran contacts (https://dmv.ri.gov/node/881), both search excerpts. Every county shows this one office.
